PART AND PROCESS NOTES
1. MATERIAL BOTH PARTS: 17-4 PH STAINLESS STEEL, UNS S17400.
ASTM A564/A564M TYPE 630, H1150, CERTIFIED.
2. CERTIFICATE SHALL IDENTIFY SPEC, TYPE, CONDITION, HEAT/LOT.
3. FINISHED CONDITION A IS PROHIBITED. MACHINE FROM H1150 BAR.
4. DATUM A: REAR MATING FACE. FLATNESS 0.03; Ra 1.6 µm MAX.
5. DATUM B: CONTROLLED CYLINDRICAL AXIS. DATUM C: C01 H1 CLOCK HOLE.
6. OPPOSITE FLANGE FACE PARALLELISM 0.03 TO A; Ra 1.6 µm MAX.
8. BREAK EDGES 0.2-0.4 EXCEPT CONTROLLED FILLET; REMOVE BURRS.
9. CLEAN/PASSIVATION PROCESS: SELECTION REQUIRED AFTER DFM/REVIEW.
10. NO WELD, PLATING, REPAIR OR MATERIAL/CONDITION SUBSTITUTION.
11. STEP HAS NOMINAL TAP-DRILL GEOMETRY; THREAD CALLOUT CONTROLS.
12. UNSPECIFIED LINEAR ±0.10; ANGLES ±0.5°; ALL FEATURES REQUIRE FAI.
13. EXACT M2/M4 FASTENERS, LENGTHS, PRELOAD, LOCKING AND REUSE:
SELECTION REQUIRED. ROBOTIS/RULAND APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE OPEN.
14. H1150 PROPERTY VALUES ARE TYPICAL, NOT RELEASED ALLOWABLES.
15. NO CAPACITY CREDIT UNTIL QUALIFIED REVIEW AND PHYSICAL PROOF.
IDENTIFIER: HR-V0-FX103-OUTPUT-ADAPTER-FAB-P0.2
R106 CORRECTION AND RELEASE BOUNDARY
R103 ONE-PIECE FX103-C01 IS REJECTED: STUB/HORN-HOLE ACCESS OVERLAP.
C01 mounts first with eight recessed horn fasteners. C02 then pilots onto C01
and attaches at the separate PCD-28 M4 pattern, leaving the Ø15 stub and
transfer fasteners accessible. This resolves nominal geometry/tool access only.
Do not quote, machine or assemble until manufacturer acceptance, exact hardware,
DFM, qualified analysis, signed FAI/proof and rig authorization are complete.
